plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Alaxala switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic, for AX2430S / AX3650S / AX3830S (enterprise PEN 21839).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU load of the Alaxala device control plane over the last minute (chassis table CpuLoad1m column of the AX2430S / AX3650S / AX3830S branch), expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100. The value is read per chassis and aggregated with max() by instance. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the used system memory of the Alaxala device in bytes (chassis table MemoryUsedSize column, reported in kB and scaled to bytes). The value is read per chassis and aggregated with max() by instance. It is used together with the free memory counter to derive overall memory utilization.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports the free system memory of the Alaxala device in bytes (chassis table MemoryFreeSize column, reported in kB and scaled to bytes). The value is read per chassis and aggregated with max() by instance. It is used together with the used memory counter to derive overall memory utilization.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the overall memory utilization of the Alaxala device, derived per chassis as used/(used+free)*100 from the chassis table memory columns (MemoryUsedSize / MemoryFreeSize) and aggregated with max() by instance. High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized routing/MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity, and can cause instability or failed allocations.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
